name: War Inc: Rising Gem Farming Guide — How to Earn 50,000 Gems Per Month
title: War Inc: Rising Gem Farming Guide — Daily and Monthly Income Sources | War Inc: Rising Wiki
meta_description: Complete guide to farming gems in War Inc: Rising. Learn every gem source — daily, weekly, and bi-weekly — plus monthly totals for F2P and paying players. Updated for current meta.
author: War Inc Wiki Team
excerpt: Gems are the most important currency in War Inc: Rising. This guide breaks down every gem source in the game — daily, weekly, and bi-weekly — with exact numbers so you can plan your monthly income and decide what to afford.

sections.heading: Why Gem Farming Matters
sections.content:
Every major progression system in War Inc: Rising runs on gems. The Wheel costs 100 gems per spin. Card Master costs 250 gems per draw. Fusion from legendary to mystic costs 450 gems. A level 6 mystic hero costs 14,400 gems through fusion or 30,000+ gems through the Wheel.

Knowing exactly how many gems you can earn each month lets you plan what to afford. A F2P player earning 17,000 gems per month has different options than a light spender earning 50,000. This guide covers every gem source with exact ranges so you can calculate your personal monthly income.

sections.heading: Daily Gem Sources
sections.content:
These are the gem sources you can collect every single day. Most scale with your rank and power, so the numbers improve as you progress.

Infinite War is the single largest daily gem source. You compete in a group of roughly 50 players. Rewards are based on your final rank within the group. At rank 23 (group 9), first place pays 400 gems. Even at the bottom of the group you earn 100 gems. If you are in a higher group, the rewards scale up. Top groups can earn 500+ gems per day. This is the one daily activity you should never skip.

Battle Pass daily missions reset every 24 hours. There are three mission slots. Each mission rewards between 120 and 170 gems depending on difficulty. You get three free rerolls per day if you do not like the available missions. The minimum you will earn is 120 gems per mission (360 total) and the maximum is 170 per mission (510 total). Over a month this adds up to 10,800 to 15,300 gems.

Gem passes are only for paying players but they are the most efficient purchase in the game. The Basic 30-Day Pass costs $5 and gives 600 gems upfront plus 100 gems per day. The Advanced 30-Day Pass costs $15 and gives 2,000 gems upfront plus 320 gems per day. Combined, these two passes give 420 gems every single day plus 2,600 upfront. Over 30 days that is 15,200 gems for $20.

Castle collection is passive gem income. Your castle (command center) generates and stores gems over time. At castle level 5, the storage cap is 100 gems and it fills in roughly 10 hours. If you collect three times per day (morning, afternoon, before bed), you earn 240 gems daily. Lower castle levels earn less but even level 3 at 50 storage cap gives 120 gems per day with two collections. This source is completely passive and requires no battles.

Your total daily gem income depends on your activity level and whether you buy the gem passes. An active F2P player with a level 5 castle earning mid-rank Infinite War rewards makes roughly 700 to 1,000 gems per day.

sections.heading: Weekly Gem Sources
sections.content:
These reset every week and require consistent participation across multiple game modes.

Hunting mode rewards gems based on your rank bracket. Lower brackets start at 150 gems. Top brackets pay 500 gems per week. Most active mid-game players settle in the 250-400 range. Hunting requires three daily attempts and coordination with your guild for boss kills.

Co-op missions have three tiers of gem rewards at 100, 200, and 300 gems depending on the mission difficulty and your completion rank. If you clear all three tiers you earn 600 gems per week. Co-op is also your primary source of wood, so there are compounding reasons to play it daily.

Clan House events alternate weekly with Guild Wars. Your guild earns a rank based on total points, and you earn an individual rank based on your personal contribution. Guild rank rewards range from 200 to 500 gems. Individual rank rewards range from 100 to 1,800 gems depending on your placement in the guild. Gulhdan reports earning 500 from guild rank and 150 from individual rank in his top-30 guild.

Battle Pass weekly missions appear once per week (two per season since seasons are 14 days). Each weekly mission rewards between 40 and 300 gems depending on difficulty. Over a month (4 weekly missions across two seasons) that is 160 to 1,200 gems.

Dragon Attack is a newer event mode that uses energy rather than tickets. Rewards are rank-based and range from 100 to 240 gems per week. The event is not very demanding since it uses energy rather than limited attempts.

Co-op ranking is separate from co-op missions. Your overall co-op rank is tracked globally and resets weekly. Rank 1 pays 500 gems. Most active players land between rank 1,000 and 10,000 which pays 150 to 250 gems. If you are above 50,000 rank you only get a chest with no gems.

Total weekly gem income ranges from roughly 1,500 (casual F2P) to 4,500+ (active high-rank player). Over a month (4 weeks) that is 6,000 to 18,000 gems.

sections.heading: Bi-Weekly Gem Sources (14-Day Seasons)
sections.content:
These sources reset with each Battle Pass season, which lasts 14 days. They are the largest lump-sum payouts.

Battle Pass seasonal missions are the eight missions at the bottom of the Battle Pass screen. They last the entire 14-day season. Free track players earn 80 to 820 gems total from these missions depending on completion. Premium track players (bought the Battle Pass for $10) earn an additional 1,900 gems from premium rewards. Total for premium: roughly 2,410 gems per season.

Arena pays out at the end of each 14-day season. You earn gems for both your global rank and your group rank. Global rank ranges from 100 to 1,000 gems. Group rank ranges from 300 to 500 gems. A mid-tier global rank of 1,600 pays around 200 gems while a group rank of 3rd place pays around 200-300 gems. Total arena payout per season: 400 to 1,500 gems.

Guild global rank also pays out each season. Top 3 guilds in each group earn 200 to 400 gems. If your guild consistently finishes first, that is 400 gems every 14 days.

Since there are roughly 2 seasons per month, multiply these numbers by 2. Total bi-weekly sources: roughly 1,000 to 5,000+ gems per month depending on your arena rank and Battle Pass status.

sections.heading: Monthly Totals — What You Can Actually Earn
sections.content:
Here are the realistic monthly gem totals broken down by player type.

F2P minimum (casual play, low ranks, no gem passes): roughly 17,000 to 20,000 gems per month. This assumes you do your daily Infinite War battles, collect your castle, complete most Battle Pass missions, and participate in weekly events at a basic level. You will not have enough for a level 6 mystic every month, but you can afford the 10-spin roulette milestone once or twice.

F2P maximum (active play, high ranks, full mission completion): roughly 35,000 to 45,000 gems per month. This requires top-rank finishes in Infinite War, maxing all Battle Pass missions, high arena placements, and active guild participation. At this level you can afford a level 6 fusion mystic (14,400 gems) every month plus regular roulette spins.

Light spender with gem passes ($20/month): roughly 46,000 to 60,000 gems per month. Gulhdan reports earning 46,000 to 50,000 gems per month with the $5 basic pass and $15 advanced pass, active play, and mid-to-high rank finishes. This is enough for three level 6 fusion mystics per month or one major roulette push to 100 spins.

Heavy spender with all passes ($60/month): roughly 60,000 to 80,000+ gems per month. Adds the Battle Pass ($10 every 14 days) and the daily mystic pack ($30/month) on top of the gem passes. At this level you can afford multiple roulette pushes and still have gems for fusion.

Theoretical maximum (rank 1 in everything): roughly 161,000 gems per month according to Gulhdan's calculations. This requires being the top player in every game mode simultaneously, which is not realistic for most players but shows the ceiling.

Note that Dragon Clash events and other limited-time events add extra gems on top of these numbers. They are not included in the monthly estimates because their schedule is irregular.

sections.heading: Special Events That Boost Gem Income
sections.content:
Dragon Clash (also called Dragon Attack or Dragon House) runs every 1.5 to 2 months. It has its own quest log and reward track separate from the Battle Pass. The event rewards gems, dragon materials, and exclusive items. If you spend money on the Dragon House packs, you get roughly 12-13 dragon materials per dollar which is efficient compared to standard gem prices.

New season releases and holiday events often include bonus gem rewards in login calendars and special missions. The Light vs Dark season and similar content updates typically add 1,000 to 3,000 extra gems over the event period.

Invite codes give a one-time bonus of 100 gems when you enter another player's code, plus additional gems for each friend you refer. This is a small source but it is free and takes 30 seconds.

Daily login rewards include gems on certain days of the month. These are small (50-100 gems per reward day) but they add up over time.

sections.heading: F2P vs P2P — Realistic Comparison
sections.content:
A dedicated F2P player earning 17,000 to 20,000 gems per month can afford one level 6 fusion mystic (14,400 gems) every month with 2,600 to 5,600 gems left over for daily spending. At this pace, you can build a full team of 7 fusion mystics to level 6 in about 7 months.

A light spender with gem passes earning 46,000 to 50,000 gems per month can afford three level 6 fusion mystics per month. Full roster in 2-3 months. You also have enough spare gems to push the roulette to 50 or 100 spins on good wheels.

An active player targeting monthly gem income should prioritize these activities in order: max Infinite War placement daily, complete all Battle Pass missions, collect castle every 6-8 hours, participate in every weekly event, maintain high arena rank each season, and join an active guild for clan house rewards.

The gap between casual and dedicated play is roughly 2x to 3x monthly gem income. Most of that gap comes from Infinite War rank and event participation, not from spending real money.

sections.heading: Common Gem Farming Mistakes
sections.content:
Missing Infinite War battles is the single biggest mistake. Three free battles per day that you do not use are lost forever. Even if you lose, you still get participation rewards. Set a daily reminder if needed.

Letting castle gems cap and overflow wastes passive income. Castle storage fills in 10 hours at level 5. If you sleep 8 hours, collect before bed and immediately after waking to maximize daily collection.

Skipping Battle Pass missions because they are inconvenient costs hundreds of gems per week. Use your three free rerolls to swap difficult missions for easier ones. Even the worst missions are worth more gems than skipping.

Ignoring arena placement at season end is a common trap. Push hard in the last 24 hours of each arena season to secure a better rank. A single rank tier improvement can mean 100-200 more gems every 14 days.

Not being in an active guild cuts off clan house and guild war gem income entirely. Join a guild that communicates and coordinates for events. The gem difference between a top guild and a casual guild is thousands per month.

mainEntity.name: How many gems can I earn per month in War Inc: Rising as a F2P player?

acceptedAnswer.text: Active F2P players earn 17,000 to 20,000 gems per month from daily and weekly sources. Dedicated players with high ranks can reach 35,000 to 45,000 gems.

mainEntity.name: What is the best daily source of gems in War Inc: Rising?

acceptedAnswer.text: Infinite War is the largest daily gem source, paying 100 to 400+ gems per day depending on your rank group and placement. Never skip your three free battles.

mainEntity.name: How many gems do gem passes give per month?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Basic 30-Day Pass ($5) gives 100 gems per day plus 600 upfront. The Advanced 30-Day Pass ($15) gives 320 gems per day plus 2,000 upfront. Combined: 420 gems daily, 15,200 gems total per month.

mainEntity.name: Can I earn enough gems for a level 6 mystic every month as F2P?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A level 6 fusion mystic costs 14,400 gems. Dedicated F2P players earning 17,000+ gems per month can afford one per month with gems left over. Building a full team of 7 takes roughly 7 months.

mainEntity.name: What is the biggest gem farming mistake?

acceptedAnswer.text: Missing Infinite War battles is the most costly mistake. Three free battles per day are lost if unused. Second is letting castle gems cap and overflow without collecting.
